asr.full_text: Hey, this is Ryan Connolly, residual Bitcoin miner, one more time, just something that was on my mind is, are you being the leader of your team that you would want to go ahead and join under? And this question gets asked by so many leaders out there, I've heard it on so many sales calls, excuse me, motivational calls, whatever you want to call them in network marketing, but it is something that there's been times that if heard that question I like man I am just not the leader that I would definitely sign under maybe we'll go ahead and recruit like a madman I I may go ahead and work my ass off all day long but at the end of the day in my is there there's always something more that I that I could possibly do to help someone and that's what network marketing is about, or what I call peer-to-peer network. I honestly am sick and tired of that network marketing name, so the peer-to-peer sales is, we're building a sales force. It's about how many people that you're helping is really what it comes down to. At the end of the day, I think it's really important, I don't care if you're working a nine to five, or if you're a full-time professional marketer like myself—the question is, is how many people on your team are you talking to? And I know every single day I am working very very hard to talk to as many people on my team as possible. That is really important. How can I help you? How can I help you grow? Sometimes you just need to set business aside and go ahead and talk to these people. They may be going through some serious shit in their life. Family members suffering the health conditions or legal issues or losing their houses and stuff like that. You got to put work aside and just be there for these people. That's so important so that's a one really important thing when it when it comes to are you really being the leader that you should be when it comes to supporting your network marketing team. And it really comes down to, obviously, we call this revenue producing activity compared to non revenue producing activity, that's NRPA or RPA for revenue producing activity. So it's important for us to help other people become effective and actually make money That's really important And if you are being in contact with your downline in talking to them okay This is one thing I love about bit club Network is I know my people are making money every single day whether they recruit anyone They're not gonna fall off off of an auto ship. So that gives me a peace of mind, it doesn't wear me out. I can call my people months from now, sometimes, because I've got thousands of people in my BIT Club networking organization. I'm not going to drive myself crazy. I go where the energy flows. That's one thing as a great leader also, we have to make the use of our time. You want to be working with a leader that makes the most out of their time. We all got our families, some of us have nine-to-fives, I don't, I'm do this full-time. I'm there for my people 24 7. I worked my ass off. I worked my ass off till 2 o'clock in the morning last night, being there for my teams. I know at the end of the day, that I can look in the morning last night being there for my teams and I know at the end of the day that I can look in the mirror and that my team can say you know what that guy helped me I know that I help at least I you know what I lose track of how many people I help a day how many phone calls of productive phone calls not just nonsense phone calls calling people but how many productive phone calls things that I can say check got something done with that person not just a little pep talk even those are important a swift kick in the ass, if you will, once in a while those are important as well but as a good leader, sometimes you need to give people a wake-up call. Sometimes you need to be a hard-ass, you need to bust their ass and say, what are you doing right now? Because it is not... we can encourage people gently. It sometimes is important for us to as great leaders to encourage people gently. Sometimes it's important for us as great leaders to encourage people hard and sometimes we have to be really strong with things because it's not about the money. Especially when it comes to Bitcoin. It's about caring for people and caring about the future and how fast that we can expedite the downward spiral of the Fiat system and the upward spiral of the fiat system and the upward spiral of bit Con you know So let me see what else to be talked about being you know as a great leader And what are you looking for when it comes to joining someone I remember I got approached by a big Club Network two times before I came out because I didn't hear the passion in the person that was Trying to recruit me into the industry. I think it's important that you align yourself with the leader out there that is passionate. I mean I passed, passed, passed on the people that try to sign me up in Bit Club network. I wasn't here and even though they may be making some decent money in there. I joined with the leader that I said, you know what, when this dude gets on the phone, my people are going to be aunt, I can go ahead and do a three-way phone call, hit the mute button and just do what I'm doing and listen to them just go ahead and rock those people on the phone and close their asses for me. That's what a great leader does thank you Joe Abel. Thank you Russ Medland for being my leaders. Thank You Bill Constane for being my leaders in bit club network. Thank you to my business partner Joby Weeks. So great leaders align themselves with great business partners. Me and Joby call ourselves the Bitcoin brothers. We kick ass. And you all out there need to go ahead and form proper relationships that form support for your downline so you guys can be great leaders together and bring more people to the top and help people walk away from that bullshit nine-to-five slave mint job. I haven't done that shit for years. Excuse my French, OK. Every time I swear I just think of Grant Cardone. He really brings it out to me sometimes. Excuse moi. Ok, but anyways you know guys, being a great leader requires a... we're in this, you've heard the quotes before. Work a few years and... hard, hard. You work really, really hard to go ahead and free yourself as an entrepreneur and it may it's gonna take the right you got to find the right vehicle out there to do that so a great leader identifies what that vehicle is gonna be for his team. It has taken me years to go ahead and find the right vehicle and when you got as much upswing potential as Bitcoin you can't go wrong. It is undeniable mathematically how big Bitcoin is going to be. So a great leader identifies that. I remember someone called me up yesterday from WorldVentures. Okay? God bless their hearts. I know where I'm going to go underneath eventually when I get my little travel company organization going and I tell you what, it's not going underneath someone that is so close-minded that they're not going to go ahead and contemplate joining a passive income opportunity and support and financial freedom. Their comeback to me was, well you're gonna get a free vacation though. I said, you know what, you could back in 1913, you could go ahead and buy 25 vacations for the price of one vacation today because the dollar is declined 96%. But you don't want to, I said, I'm gonna go ahead and join a person in WorldVentures down the road that when WorldVentures or whatever road that when WorldVentures or whatever travel Network out there accepts Bitcoin, I don't support any other companies out there pretty much that don't accept Bitcoin. So that's where I'm going with things and a great leader leads by example. A great leader draws line in the sand and says, I'm not gonna do this, I'm gonna do this. I know I'm rambling on, but you guys get the point. So are you a great leader? Would you look? How many of your team members are you talking to per day? And you know what? If you can't look at yourself in the mirror and answer that simple question, go ahead and smack your face right now, and that will be the first step on you becoming a great leader. All right, cheers everyone. Ryan Conley, Residual Bitcoin Miner signing off. Subscribe to my YouTube channel, get your ass in gear and go ahead and make your team some money now, bye-bye.
